worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.summary: Grab an adjacent opponent and throw it over your head to land behind you, driving it out of the fight; an opponent with a reserve is truly switched out. The slam deals Fighting contact damage.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.use.0: Throw an opponent that rushed you over your shoulder
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.use.1: Counter in melee and clear an opponent out of your face
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.use.2: Slam a sturdy target out of melee and hit it on the way
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.descriptio: Grab one opponent within %2$s blocks and slam it for about %1$s Fighting contact damage.
The opponent is thrown over your head to land about %1$s blocks behind you, peaking around %2$s blocks high over %3$s seconds.
Anyone thrown is marked Routed for %1$s seconds; while it lasts, anything closer than %2$s blocks is thrown another %3$s blocks every 10 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.tight.on: Tight grip on: slam x1.1 and rout x1.3, at the cost of x0.8 throw distance.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.tight.off: Tight grip off: throw distance x1.3, farther, at the cost of slam x0.95 and rout x0.75.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.growth.0: At level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.growth.1: At level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s and the throw reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.circlethrow.preference: On: slam x1.1 and rout x1.3 for a close, heavy throw at x0.8 distance. Off: throw distance x1.3, farther, with slam x0.95 and rout x0.75.
The companion only considers a circle throw on a threat within this distance; closer ranks higher, farther goes to the shared approach logic.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to grab. Off: it only does so when the target is already in reach.
